script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'heard-whats-next',
  description: 'Assess the Heard codebase across 7 dimensions and synthesize a prioritized "what else" roadmap',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Assess', detail: 'one read-only agent per dimension, grounded in docs + code' },
    { title: 'Synthesize', detail: 'dedupe + rank into a roadmap' },
  ],
}

const COMMON = `
Project root is the cwd. "Heard" is a two-sided marketplace (customers pay to talk with companion
listeners who are all blind/visually impaired; non-clinical, never therapy; accessibility is the
product). Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, TS strict, Supabase (Postgres+Auth+Storage), Tailwind v4,
Zod, Vitest/RTL/jest-axe, Playwright. Mock mode (INTEGRATIONS_MODE=mock) via adapters in
lib/integrations/*. Money is integer cents in lib/pricing.ts. The MVP (M0–M9) and the
Listener/Customer/Admin dashboards (M10–M14) are all built and merged to main.

Governing docs at repo root: SPEC.md, BUILD_PLAN.md, DASHBOARDS_BUILD_PLAN.md,
DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md. READ the docs relevant to your dimension AND the
actual code (use Read/Grep/Glob). Report only REAL, grounded gaps — things actually missing,
partial, risky, or debt — not hypotheticals. For each, give a concrete file/doc pointer and a
specific recommendation. Be exhaustive within your dimension; it's fine to return many findings.`

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['findings'],
  properties: { findings: { type: 'array', items: {
    type: 'object', additionalProperties: false,
    required: ['title', 'status', 'severity', 'effort', 'detail', 'pointer', 'recommendation'],
    properties: {
      title: { type: 'string' },
      status: { type: 'string', enum: ['missing', 'partial', 'risk', 'debt', 'polish'] },
      severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['high', 'medium', 'low'] },
      effort: { type: 'string', enum: ['S', 'M', 'L'] },
      detail: { type: 'string' },
      pointer: { type: 'string' },
      recommendation: { type: 'string' },
    },
  } } },
}

const DIMS = [
  { key: 'spec-coverage', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Spec coverage & feature completeness. Read SPEC.md (all sections, esp. §5 booking/cancel policy, §11 routes, §12 out-of-scope), BUILD_PLAN.md, DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md (the "later" columns + moderation/notifications), and CLAUDE.md "Out of scope". Identify what is specified-but-unbuilt or only partially built: the notifications table (is it created? used?), moderation/reporting beyond the minimal hook, reschedule/cancel edge cases vs SPEC §5, the downloadable receipt (real artifact vs link?), language/i18n actually switchable, performance analytics, messaging, spending summary, subscriptions. Distinguish "intentionally deferred (documented)" from "gap".' },
  { key: 'security-rls', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Security, RLS & data protection. Read all supabase/migrations/*.sql RLS policies + guard triggers, lib/supabase/* (client/server/admin/proxy), every "use server" action under app/**/actions.ts, and lib/db/queries.ts. Hunt for: tables missing RLS or with overly-broad policies, service-role key exposure to client, missing ownership/role checks in server actions, IDOR, injection (PostgREST .or/.filter), privileged-column writes, public reads leaking private fields (bg_check_ref/payout_account_ref), auth boundary holes in proxy.ts, and whether is_suspended is fully enforced everywhere it should be.' },
  { key: 'prod-readiness', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Production readiness & ops. Read .github/workflows/*, package.json scripts, .env.example, next.config.*, README.md, supabase/config.toml, and lib/integrations/*/real.ts. Assess: CI completeness (does it run typecheck/lint/test/build/e2e? does e2e have a DB?), env var completeness + secret handling, the INTEGRATIONS_MODE=real swap path (do real.ts stubs exist for Stripe/Zoom/Checkr and does the app compile with real?), deploy story (Vercel + Supabase migrations), error monitoring/logging, rate limiting, seed-vs-prod data safety, and any missing operational guardrails.' },
  { key: 'test-coverage', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Test coverage & quality gates. Read tests/** (unit, component, e2e), vitest/playwright configs, and cross-reference against app code. Identify untested surfaces: server actions (booking/session/review/admin), lib/db/queries (RLS behavior), pricing edge cases (overage rounding, commission, tips, cancellation), adapters, axe coverage per dashboard screen, and E2E gaps (cancel/reschedule, suspension enforcement, payout run, error/404). Note any flaky-by-design tests or missing assertions.' },
  { key: 'accessibility', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Accessibility (the product\'s whole point — WCAG 2.2 AA floor, AAA body). Read components/ui/*, the session/call screens (app/(customer)/session/**, app/(provider)/provider/session/**), Dialog, forms, and SPEC.md §10. Beyond the M14 dashboard pass, find remaining gaps: the app-wide <Link><Button> nested-interactive (<a><button>) pattern, reduced-motion handling, 200% zoom/reflow, focus order + focus trap in Dialog, live-region coverage on the live call (timer/captions/mute), form error association, skip-link correctness, and any icon-only controls. Verify contrast claims against the real @theme tokens in app/globals.css — do not guess ratios.' },
  { key: 'code-quality', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Code quality & tech debt. Skim the codebase for: duplicated logic that should be shared, dead code / orphaned i18n keys, error swallowing (empty catches, ignored results), any-typing or unsafe casts, inconsistent patterns across the three dashboards, the Link>Button polymorphism debt, magic numbers/literals (esp. money or commission outside lib/pricing.ts), and places that violate CLAUDE.md golden rules. Be specific with file:line.' },
  { key: 'ux-polish', prompt: 'DIMENSION: Product UX & polish. Read the page components across marketing/auth/browse/booking/session/account/provider/admin and the design brief (Interactive_Prototype_Design_Brief.md). Assess: empty/loading/error-state coverage, responsive/mobile behavior (the app is desktop-first 85%-width capped 1500px — does it degrade gracefully?), microcopy consistency vs the brief\'s voice, onboarding friction, discoverability of key actions (talk now, favorite, rebook, report), and any rough edges a real user would hit. Concrete, not vague.' },
]

phase('Assess')
const assessed = await parallel(DIMS.map((d) => () =>
  agent(`${COMMON}\n\n${d.prompt}`, { label: `assess:${d.key}`, phase: 'Assess', agentType: 'Explore', schema: SCHEMA })
    .then((r) => ({ dim: d.key, findings: (r?.findings ?? []) }))
))

const all = assessed.filter(Boolean).flatMap((a) => a.findings.map((f) => ({ ...f, dim: a.dim })))
log(`Assessment gathered ${all.length} findings across ${assessed.filter(Boolean).length} dimensions.`)

phase('Synthesize')
const ROADMAP_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['topRisks', 'quickWins', 'roadmap', 'deferred'],
  properties: {
    topRisks: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'highest-severity correctness/security items to fix first' },
    quickWins: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'high-value low-effort (S) items' },
    roadmap: { type: 'array', items: {
      type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['rank', 'theme', 'severity', 'effort', 'items', 'rationale'],
      properties: {
        rank: { type: 'number' },
        theme: { type: 'string' },
        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['high', 'medium', 'low'] },
        effort: { type: 'string', enum: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'] },
        items: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
        rationale: { type: 'string' },
      },
    } },
    deferred: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'intentionally-out-of-scope items (documented), for completeness' },
  },
}
const synthesis = await agent(
  `You are the synthesis lead. Below are raw assessment findings (JSON) from 7 dimensions of the ` +
  `Heard codebase. Dedupe overlapping items, drop anything that is clearly a documented intentional ` +
  `deferral (list those under "deferred"), and produce a PRIORITIZED roadmap. Rank themes by ` +
  `(severity × value ÷ effort). Surface the top correctness/security risks first, then quick wins, ` +
  `then the ranked roadmap of larger themes. Be concrete and honest — this product's users are blind, ` +
  `so accessibility and safety regressions matter most.\n\nFINDINGS JSON:\n${JSON.stringify(all)}`,
  { label: 'synthesize', phase: 'Synthesize', schema: ROADMAP_SCHEMA }
)

return { dimensionCount: assessed.filter(Boolean).length, findingCount: all.length, ...synthesis, rawByDim: assessed.filter(Boolean).map((a) => ({ dim: a.dim, count: a.findings.length })) }

topRisks: Nested <Link><Button> interactive elements (WCAG 2.5.1 fail) in app/(customer)/listeners/[id]/page.tsx:80-90 and app/(customer)/session/[id]/summary/page.tsx:95-100, repeated 20+ times app-wide. Screen readers announce 'link' while the focused role is 'button' — roles and ARIA state diverge. For a blind-user product this is the single highest-priority a11y defect. Fix with a unified LinkButton primitive (Button accepting href/as).

Hardcoded '95% / 5%' commission copy in messages/en.json:114 (provider.step3Help) violates CLAUDE.md golden rule 3 (commission must come from PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE, never a literal). If the rate changes, providers see a number that contradicts the admin dashboard's live getCommissionRate() — a money-correctness/trust bug. Interpolate take-home from getCommissionRate() at render.

Suspended providers can still declineBooking and setAvailability (app/(provider)/provider/actions.ts:80-109). Both only call requireRole('provider') with no is_suspended check, unlike createBooking and startSession which guard correctly. A suspended bad actor can keep toggling 'available now' and surfacing in browse — a safety-enforcement gap. Add the same `if (profile.is_suspended) return { ok: false }` guard.

No RLS enforcement tests and no server-action tests exist. CLAUDE.md rule 4 mandates RLS on every table, but nothing verifies a customer can't read another customer's bookings or a provider another's earnings. Critical business logic (createBooking, endSession accounting, cancelBooking policy windows, setUserSuspended cascades) has zero direct coverage — auth-bypass and money bugs could ship undetected.

CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs only typecheck/lint/unit tests — it never runs `npm run build` or Playwright e2e. A broken production build or INTEGRATIONS_MODE=real regression would merge to main unnoticed; mock adapter ledger code could ship to clients if tree-shaking silently breaks.
quickWins: Add is_suspended guard to declineBooking and setAvailability (app/(provider)/provider/actions.ts) — copy the existing pattern from createBooking. ~4 lines, closes a safety hole.
Dynamically interpolate provider take-home and fee from getCommissionRate() in the onboarding step-3 copy instead of the literal '95% / 5%' in messages/en.json:114.
Add `npm run build` as a CI step in .github/workflows/ci.yml to catch production-build and real-integration compile breaks.
Set initial focus inside Dialog (autoFocus on the close/first focusable element after showModal) so keyboard and screen-reader users land in the modal — components/ui/Dialog.tsx.

Make the CallStage session timer announce meaningfully: drop the static 'Session timer' aria-live on per-second ticks; announce milestones via the existing announce() Toast instead — components/session/CallStage.tsx:81-87.
Add confirmation before ending an in-progress session (CallStage End button, CallStage.tsx:63-68) so a stray click doesn't cut off a vulnerable caller mid-conversation.
Improve the Browse empty state with a 'Clear filters' action and guidance instead of bare 'No results found' — app/(customer)/browse/page.tsx:59-62.

Add explicit `for delete using (false)` policies (or clarifying comments) on reviews, reports, sessions, payments so immutability intent is auditable — supabase/migrations/20260605130000_m1_data_model.sql.
Make SafetyBanner crisis/report access reachable without scrolling to page bottom (sticky footer or header link) — app/layout.tsx:47, components/shared/SafetyBanner.tsx.

Add provider status + availability re-check in the booking page loader so a now-suspended/offline listener yields a friendly 'no longer available' card instead of a hold-then-error — app/(customer)/book/[providerId]/page.tsx:19-25.

items: Replace all 20+ nested <Link><Button> with a single LinkButton primitive (Button accepting href/as) — fixes WCAG 2.5.1 nested-interactive fail across marketing/customer/provider/admin
Dialog initial focus management (autoFocus first focusable after showModal) — components/ui/Dialog.tsx
Session timer screen-reader announcement: milestone announcements via Toast, not per-second aria-live — CallStage.tsx
Reinforce mute/captions toggle state with non-color cues (text/border) for color-blind users — CallStage.tsx:99-121
Wrap header navigation in a <nav> landmark — components/shared/AppHeader.tsx
roadmap.rationale: The product's entire premise is dignity and usability for blind/low-vision users; a11y defects are the highest-value-to-fix class. Nested interactives are a hard WCAG fail that confuses AT role announcements on the most-used CTAs. Bundle the smaller a11y polish (focus, timer, toggle state, nav landmark) into the same pass since they touch the same files and reviewer context.

items: Add is_suspended guards to declineBooking and setAvailability — app/(provider)/provider/actions.ts:80-109
Interpolate commission copy from getCommissionRate() instead of literal 95%/5% — messages/en.json:114 + onboarding step 3
Extract magic +15 buffer to a named CALL_SESSION_BUFFER_MINUTES constant — app/(customer)/session/actions.ts:53
Add a friendly 'listener unavailable' path when a provider is suspended/offline mid-booking — book/[providerId]/page.tsx
roadmap.rationale: Small, surgical fixes to correctness/safety invariants the spec explicitly mandates (commission never a literal; suspension = full lockdown). Very low effort, directly protects money math and bad-actor containment for a vulnerable user base.

roadmap.theme: Test coverage for critical paths (server actions, RLS, accounting, suspension)
items: RLS enforcement test suite against a real/isolated Supabase: per-table cross-tenant read/write denial (bookings, sessions, payouts, reviews, payments, reports, providers)

Server-action integration tests: createBooking (suspended parties), endSession accounting (overage→commission→earnings→capture), cancelBooking time windows, setUserSuspended status cascades, completeOnboarding field combos
Full end-session accounting integration test (startSession→elapsed→endSession→capture amount→session row→booking status)
Suspension enforcement tests (customer can't book suspended provider; provider can't toggle availability/join)
Pricing edge cases: rounding boundaries, fractional commission, very long sessions, invalid blockMinutes
Earnings aggregation edge cases (week/month boundaries, null dates, empty sessions w/ pending payouts) — lib/earnings.ts
roadmap.rationale: Highest-leverage durable risk reduction: these guard the auth/ownership and money invariants that this two-sided marketplace depends on. RLS untested means a misconfigured policy ships silently; action-level tests catch payment and authorization bugs the component-mocked tests cannot. Large effort but blocks the most expensive class of production incident.

items: Complete CI: add `npm run build` + Playwright e2e job (spin up local Supabase, db reset) with DB isolation/global setup — .github/workflows/ci.yml, playwright.config.ts
Error monitoring + structured logging (Sentry/pino) for actions, route handlers, and payment/session state changes — currently only a client console.error in app/error.tsx
Startup env-var validation via Zod (lib/env.ts): required keys per INTEGRATIONS_MODE, valid PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE, fail loud
Webhook handlers (app/api/webhooks/payments, /calls) with signature verification + idempotency — required before flipping to real integrations
Health-check endpoint + post-deploy verification; document migration rollback/reversibility strategy
Rate limiting on booking/session-creation server actions
roadmap.rationale: These don't block the mock-mode MVP but become hard launch gates the moment real Stripe/Zoom/Checkr go live (per CLAUDE.md out-of-scope flips). CI gaps actively let regressions merge today, so the CI + observability + env-validation items are worth pulling forward even before real integrations; webhooks/rate-limiting can land with the integration milestone.

roadmap.theme: UX polish for vulnerable / low-vision users
items: Confirm-before-end on in-progress sessions + beforeunload warning — CallStage.tsx
Browse: empty-state guidance + 'Clear filters', loading feedback on filter apply (useTransition + announced 'Loading listeners'), favorited-state visual+label on cards
VoicePlayer loading/error states ('Loading audio…', 'Audio unavailable; transcript below')
Sticky/persistent crisis + report access (SafetyBanner) reachable without scrolling
Account page density: collapsible/tabbed sections to reduce magnifier cognitive load
Pre-call mic-check affordance + 'what to expect' + prominent cancel — SessionFlow.tsx
Clarify tip 'Skip' prominence and post-call billing explanation; reschedule UI exposure on UpcomingBookings
Provider 'Profile health': 'Action required' + per-item 'Fix this' links for rejected/suspended
roadmap.rationale: Reduces friction and anxiety for the lonely/vulnerable target audience and prevents costly mistakes (accidental session-end charges, lost crisis access). Medium severity because flows function today, but several items (confirm-before-end, loading announcements, sticky crisis link) double as accessibility improvements, raising their value.

items: LinkButton component (also resolves the rank-1 a11y fix — do once)
Replace 'as unknown as PublicProvider[]' double casts with type guards / Supabase generics — lib/db/queries.ts
Centralize fieldErrorsFrom() Zod-error mapping into lib/validation/utils.ts
Share StatusConfig<T> map + table column shapes across customer/provider/admin dashboards
Differentiate VoiceIntroRecorder error messages (permission vs unsupported vs upload)
Document RLS assumptions atop lib/db/queries.ts; add escapeFilterTerm helper + golden rule for .or()/.filter()
Prune unused i18n 'page.*' keys; clarify Dialog catch-block comments and PUBLIC_PROVIDER_COLUMNS comment
roadmap.rationale: Lowers future-change cost and reduces a class of latent bugs (type-cast escapes, inconsistent statuses, conflated error messages). Low severity and partly overlapping with higher-ranked work — schedule opportunistically, and do LinkButton/escapeFilterTerm/RLS-doc items alongside the a11y and security passes they reinforce.

deferred: Messaging between customers and listeners — DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md §1 'Later', SPEC.md §12 out of scope. No schema/route/component; correctly deferred.
Subscriptions / recurring billing — SPEC.md §12 and CLAUDE.md explicitly out of scope. Pricing is per-block only; schema/adapters kept ready.
Performance analytics (profile views, voice-intro plays, conversion) — DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md §1 'Later'. No tracking tables; documented deferral.
Spending summary aggregate on customer dashboard — DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md §2 'Later'. Individual payments/receipts present; aggregate view deferred.

Notification dispatch + preferences UI — table exists (M10) but unused; settings shows a mock 'On' badge. Deferred per DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md §1/§2. Note: add the missing INSERT policy on the notifications table when this is built (currently SELECT/UPDATE only, blocking inserts).
Language/locale switching UI — profiles.locale column + i18n.ts ready, English-only per SPEC.md §1. Read-only display intentional; selector deferred.

Editable admin config (commission rate in DB) — DASHBOARDS_REQUIREMENTS.md §3 'Later'; currently read from PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE env, displayed read-only. Optional app_config table is a documented fast-follow.
PDF receipts — current plain-text receipt is functional and screen-reader friendly; PDF is a nice-to-have, keep text fallback. Documented as intentional.
Real Stripe/Zoom/Checkr integration implementations — real.ts stubs throw NotImplemented by design; out of scope until the integration milestone (linked design docs recommended at that time).
GDPR/CCPA compliance docs, data-residency, audit-log table — legal/product decision, not a code blocker for mock-mode MVP.

200%-zoom/reflow and ultra-small-screen (<320px) automated tests — test-coverage gaps (design is responsive); worth adding but not a shipping blocker. Note: app is intentionally desktop-first per project memory.
Favorites table — already fully implemented and integrated (addFavorite/removeFavorite + FavoriteListeners). No action needed; listed only to confirm it is NOT an open gap.
